<!--
NOTA: Se realiza una visualización que ayudará a explicar que son los tag SNPs.
-->

```{r}
#| label: Gráfica de tag SNP

data.frame(x = 1.0, y = 1.0) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  
  # Se dibujan dos cromosomas:
  annotate(geom = 'segment', x = 1.01, xend = 1.01, y = 3.0, yend = 4.0, colour = 'black', alpha = 0.1, linewidth = 4.8, linetype = 'solid', lineend = 'round') +
  annotate(geom = 'segment', x = 1.02, xend = 1.02, y = 3.0, yend = 4.0, colour = 'black', alpha = 0.1, linewidth = 4.8, linetype = 'solid', lineend = 'round') +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 1.015, y = 2.9, label = 'Cromosomas', size = 7.2, colour = 'black') +

  # Se dibuja el locus donde estará el SNP:
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.009, xmax = 1.011, ymin = 3.88, ymax = 3.9, colour = 'red', fill = 'red', alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.4, linetype = 'longdash') +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.019, xmax = 1.021, ymin = 3.88, ymax = 3.9, colour = 'red', fill = 'red', alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.4, linetype = 'longdash') +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 1.003, y = 3.89, label = 'Locus', size = 4.2, colour = 'black') +
  
  # Se dibuja uno de los cromosomas más grande:
  annotate(geom = 'segment', x = 1.05, xend = 1.10, y = 2.5, yend = 2.5, colour = 'black', alpha = 0.1, linewidth = 28.8, linetype = 'solid', lineend = 'round') +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.105, xmax = 1.107, ymin = 2.5, ymax = 2.5, colour = 'black', fill = 'black', alpha = 0.1, linewidth = 8.4) +
  annotate(geom = 'segment', x = 1.112, xend = 1.162, y = 2.5, yend = 2.5, colour = 'black', alpha = 0.1, linewidth = 28.8, linetype = 'solid', lineend = 'round') +

  # Se dibujan los maracdores (SNPs):
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.05, xmax = 1.053, ymin = 2.40, ymax = 2.60, colour = 'red', fill = 'red', alpha = 0.4) +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.055, xmax = 1.058, ymin = 2.40, ymax = 2.60, colour = 'black', fill = 'black', alpha = 0.01) +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.060, xmax = 1.063, ymin = 2.40, ymax = 2.60, colour = 'black', fill = 'black', alpha = 0.01) +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.065, xmax = 1.068, ymin = 2.40, ymax = 2.60, colour = 'black', fill = 'black', alpha = 0.01) +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.070, xmax = 1.073, ymin = 2.40, ymax = 2.60, colour = 'black', fill = 'black', alpha = 0.01) +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.075, xmax = 1.078, ymin = 2.40, ymax = 2.60, colour = 'black', fill = 'black', alpha = 0.01) +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.080, xmax = 1.083, ymin = 2.40, ymax = 2.60, colour = 'black', fill = 'black', alpha = 0.01) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 1.092, y = 2.50, label = 'ADN', size = 7.2, colour = 'black') +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.03, xmax = 1.033, ymin = 2.60, ymax = 2.80, colour = 'red', fill = 'red', alpha = 0.2) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 1.0315, y = 2.75, label = 'A', size = 4.2, colour = 'black') +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 1.0315, y = 2.65, label = 'T', size = 4.2, colour = 'black') +
  geom_curve(x = 1.05, xend = 1.035, y = 2.55, yend = 2.70, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, 'inch')), size = 0.8, color = 'black', curvature = 0.0, linetype = 'solid') +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.03, xmax = 1.033, ymin = 2.20, ymax = 2.40, colour = 'red', fill = 'red', alpha = 0.01) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 1.0315, y = 2.35, label = 'C', size = 4.2, colour = 'black') +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 1.0315, y = 2.25, label = 'G', size = 4.2, colour = 'black') +
  geom_curve(x = 1.05, xend = 1.035, y = 2.45, yend = 2.30, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, 'inch')), size = 0.8, color = 'black', curvature = 0.0, linetype = 'solid') +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 1.054, y = 2.10, label = 'SNP', size = 4.2, colour = 'black') +
  geom_curve(x = 1.052, xend = 1.0515, y = 2.16, yend = 2.315, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, 'inch')), size = 0.4, color = 'black', curvature = -0.1, linetype = 'solid') +
  geom_curve(x = 1.0215, xend = 1.0515, y = 3.89, yend = 2.745, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, 'inch')), size = 0.8, color = 'black', curvature = -0.1, linetype = 'longdash') +
  
  # Se dibujan los SNPs en desequilibrio de ligamiento (LD):
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 1.0265, y = 1.32, label = 'SNP', size = 5.2, colour = 'black') +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.025, xmax = 1.028, ymin = 1.05, ymax = 1.25, colour = 'red', fill = 'red', alpha = 0.4) +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.030, xmax = 1.033, ymin = 1.05, ymax = 1.25, colour = 'black', fill = 'black', alpha = 0.001) +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.035, xmax = 1.038, ymin = 1.05, ymax = 1.25, colour = 'black', fill = 'black', alpha = 0.001) +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.040, xmax = 1.043, ymin = 1.05, ymax = 1.25, colour = 'black', fill = 'black', alpha = 0.001) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 1.0465, y = 1.32, label = 'SNP', size = 5.2, colour = 'black') +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.045, xmax = 1.048, ymin = 1.05, ymax = 1.25, colour = 'cyan', fill = 'cyan', alpha = 0.4) +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.050, xmax = 1.053, ymin = 1.05, ymax = 1.25, colour = 'black', fill = 'black', alpha = 0.001) +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.055, xmax = 1.058, ymin = 1.05, ymax = 1.25, colour = 'black', fill = 'black', alpha = 0.001) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 1.0615, y = 1.32, label = 'SNP', size = 5.2, colour = 'black') +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.060, xmax = 1.063, ymin = 1.05, ymax = 1.25, colour = 'orange', fill = 'orange', alpha = 0.4) +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.065, xmax = 1.068, ymin = 1.05, ymax = 1.25, colour = 'black', fill = 'black', alpha = 0.001) +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.070, xmax = 1.073, ymin = 1.05, ymax = 1.25, colour = 'black', fill = 'black', alpha = 0.001) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 1.0765, y = 1.32, label = 'SNP', size = 5.2, colour = 'black') +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.075, xmax = 1.078, ymin = 1.05, ymax = 1.25, colour = 'green', fill = 'green', alpha = 0.4) +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.080, xmax = 1.083, ymin = 1.05, ymax = 1.25, colour = 'black', fill = 'black', alpha = 0.001) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 1.0865, y = 1.32, label = 'SNP', size = 5.2, colour = 'black') +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.085, xmax = 1.088, ymin = 1.05, ymax = 1.25, colour = 'yellow', fill = 'yellow', alpha = 0.4) +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.090, xmax = 1.093, ymin = 1.05, ymax = 1.25, colour = 'black', fill = 'black', alpha = 0.001) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 1.123, y = 1.23, label = 'SNPs en desequili-', size = 7.2, colour = 'black') +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 1.123, y = 1.07, label = 'brio de ligamiento', size = 7.2, colour = 'black') +
  geom_curve(x = 1.1, xend = 1.095, y = 1.15, yend = 1.15, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, 'inch')), size = 0.8, color = 'black', curvature = 0.0, linetype = 'solid') +

  # Se dibujan los SNPs en haplotipos, entre ellos el tag SNP:
  #annotate(geom = 'text', x = 1.0435, y = 0.49, label = 'QTL', size = 3.2, colour = 'black') +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.042, xmax = 1.045, ymin = 0.25, ymax = 0.45, colour = 'red', fill = 'red', alpha = 0.4) +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.047, xmax = 1.050, ymin = 0.25, ymax = 0.45, colour = 'cyan', fill = 'cyan', alpha = 0.4) +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.052, xmax = 1.055, ymin = 0.25, ymax = 0.45, colour = 'orange', fill = 'orange', alpha = 0.4) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 1.0585, y = 0.19, label = 'tag', size = 5.2, colour = 'black') +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 1.0585, y = 0.07, label = 'SNP', size = 5.2, colour = 'black') +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.057, xmax = 1.060, ymin = 0.25, ymax = 0.45, colour = 'green', fill = 'green', alpha = 0.4) +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.062, xmax = 1.065, ymin = 0.25, ymax = 0.45, colour = 'yellow', fill = 'yellow', alpha = 0.4) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 1.085, y = 0.35, label = 'Haplotipo', size = 7.2, colour = 'black') +
  geom_curve(x = 1.073, xend = 1.067, y = 0.35, yend = 0.35, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, 'inch')), size = 0.8, color = 'black', curvature = 0.0, linetype = 'solid') +

  # Se dibujan las fechas de los SNPs que por LD se transmiten juntos a la siguiente generación:
  geom_curve(x = 1.0265, xend = 1.0435, y = 1.02, yend = 0.54, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, 'inch')), size = 0.8, color = 'black', curvature = 0.0, linetype = 'longdash') +
  geom_curve(x = 1.0465, xend = 1.0485, y = 1.02, yend = 0.50, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, 'inch')), size = 0.8, color = 'black', curvature = 0.0, linetype = 'longdash') +
  geom_curve(x = 1.0615, xend = 1.0535, y = 1.02, yend = 0.50, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, 'inch')), size = 0.8, color = 'black', curvature = 0.0, linetype = 'longdash') +
  geom_curve(x = 1.0765, xend = 1.0585, y = 1.02, yend = 0.54, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, 'inch')), size = 0.8, color = 'black', curvature = 0.0, linetype = 'longdash') +
  geom_curve(x = 1.0865, xend = 1.0635, y = 1.02, yend = 0.54, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, 'inch')), size = 0.8, color = 'black', curvature = 0.0, linetype = 'longdash') +

  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1.0, 1.18)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.0, 4.0)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank())

ggsave('expo_Cartagena/Figuras/tag_SNP.png', width = 30, height = 20, units = 'cm')
```

<!--
NOTA: Se realiza una visualización en donde se observa un pedigrí.
-->

```{r}
#| label: Gráfica de pedigrí

Puntos <- data.frame(x = c(1.0, 1.5, 0.75, 1.75, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 1.75, 2.25), y = c(c(2.8, 2.8, 1.5, 1.5, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2, -1.1, -1.1)))

Punto_x <- data.frame(x = 1.0, y = 2.8)

data.frame(x = 1.0, y = 1.0) |>
  ggplot() +
  
  geom_point(aes(x = x, y = y), data = Puntos, size = 5.6, shape = 21, color = 'black', fill = 'black', alpha = 0.8) +
  
  # Se construye las lineas que unen a cada individuo en el pedigrí:
  annotate(geom = 'segment', x = 1.0, xend = 0.75, y = 2.8, yend = 1.5, colour = 'black', size = 0.8) +
  annotate(geom = 'segment', x = 1.5, xend = 0.75, y = 2.8, yend = 1.5, colour = 'black', size = 0.8) +
  annotate(geom = 'segment', x = 1.5, xend = 1.25, y = 2.8, yend = 1.5, colour = 'black', size = 0.8) +
  annotate(geom = 'segment', x = 1.5, xend = 1.75, y = 2.8, yend = 1.5, colour = 'black', size = 0.8) +
  annotate(geom = 'segment', x = 1.25, xend = 1.0, y = 1.5, yend = 0.2, colour = 'black', size = 0.8) +
  annotate(geom = 'segment', x = 1.75, xend = 2.0, y = 1.5, yend = 0.2, colour = 'black', size = 0.8) +
  annotate(geom = 'segment', x = 1.75, xend = 1.5, y = 1.5, yend = 0.2, colour = 'black', size = 0.8) +  
  annotate(geom = 'segment', x = 1.75, xend = 2.0, y = -1.1, yend = 0.2, colour = 'black', size = 0.8) +
  annotate(geom = 'segment', x = 2.25, xend = 2.0, y = -1.1, yend = 0.2, colour = 'black', size = 0.8) +

  # Se indica el individuo sin información de fenotipo:
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 0.55, xmax = 1.05, ymin = 0.9, ymax = 1.3, colour = 'orange', fill = 'orange', alpha = 0.1) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 0.8, y = 1.1, label = 'Sin fenotipo.', size = 3.2, colour = 'black') +
  geom_point(aes(x = x, y = y), data = Punto_x, size = 9.6, shape = 'X', color = 'red', fill = 'red', alpha = 0.8) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.5, 2.45)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1.3, 3.0)) +  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank())

ggsave('expo_Cartagena/Figuras/ped_nadiv.png', width = 10, height = 10, units = 'cm')
```

<!--
NOTA: Se realiza una visualización donde se representen los marcadores a densidad media (50k) y alta (HD).
-->

```{r}
#| label: Graficas de densidades 50k y HD

# Se dibuja dos matriz matrices que representen la unión de ambas densidades y así formar una matriz de densidades combinadas ----

data.frame(x = 1.0, y = 1.0) |>
  ggplot() +

  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.0, xmax = 2.0, ymin = 1.0, ymax = 2.0, colour = 'black', fill = 'black', alpha = 0.2) +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.0, xmax = 3.0, ymin = 1.0, ymax = 3.0, colour = 'black', fill = 'black', alpha = 0.01, linewidth = 1.2, linetype = 'dashed', ) +
    
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank())

ggsave('expo_Cartagena/Figuras/geno_50k-HD.png', width = 10, height = 10, units = 'cm')

# Se dibuja la matriz de 50k ----

ggplot() +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.0, xmax = 2.0, ymin = 1.0, ymax = 2.0, colour = 'green', fill = 'green', alpha = 0.4) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank())

ggsave('expo_Cartagena/Figuras/geno_50k.png', width = 10, height = 10, units = 'cm')

# Se dibuja la matriz de HD ----

ggplot() +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.0, xmax = 2.0, ymin = 1.0, ymax = 2.0, colour = 'cyan', fill = 'cyan', alpha = 0.4) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank())

ggsave('expo_Cartagena/Figuras/geno_HD.png', width = 10, height = 10, units = 'cm')
```

<!--
NOTA: Se realiza una visualización donde se observa como se realizo el método LR.
-->

```{r}
#| label: Hola

data.frame(x = 1.0, y = 1.0) |>
  ggplot() +

  # Se dibujan los datos completos y paciales:
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.0, xmax = 9.0, ymin = 1.0, ymax = 1.25, colour = 'orange', fill = 'orange', alpha = 0.2) +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.0, xmax = 12.0, ymin = 1.75, ymax = 2.0, colour = 'orange', fill = 'orange', alpha = 0.2) +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 10.5, xmax = 12.0, ymin = 1.0, ymax = 1.25, colour = 'orange', fill = 'orange', alpha = 0.2) +

  
  # Se dibuja una línea que corresponde a los individuos focales (o de validación):
  annotate(geom = 'segment', x = 9.0, xend = 9.0, y = 0.95, yend = 2.05, colour = 'black', alpha = 1.2, linewidth = 0.8, linetype = 'longdash') +
  annotate(geom = 'segment', x = 10.5, xend = 10.5, y = 0.95, yend = 2.05, colour = 'black', alpha = 1.2, linewidth = 0.8, linetype = 'longdash') +
  geom_curve(x = 11.1, xend = 10.1, y = 1.68, yend = 1.73, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, 'inch')), size = 0.4, color = 'black', curvature = -0.2, linetype = 'solid') +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 12.5, y = 1.65, label = 'Validación', size = 3.8, colour = 'black') +

  # Se indica los EBV completos y parciales:
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 14.8, y = 1.125, label = 'EBV completo', size = 4.8, colour = 'black') +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 14.8, y = 1.875, label = 'EBV parcial', size = 4.8, colour = 'black') +
  geom_curve(x = 12.2, xend = 12.8, y = 1.125, yend = 1.125, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, 'inch')), size = 1.8, color = 'black', curvature = 0.0, linetype = 'solid') +
  geom_curve(x = 12.2, xend = 12.8, y = 1.875, yend = 1.875, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, 'inch')), size = 1.8, color = 'black', curvature = 0.0, linetype = 'solid') +
  
  # Se escriben las formulas del método LR:
  geom_curve(x = 16.2, xend = 16.8, y = 1.5, yend = 1.5, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, 'inch')), size = 1.8, color = 'black', curvature = 0.0, linetype = 'solid') +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 17.2, xmax = 21.2, ymin = 0.95, ymax = 2.05, colour = 'black', fill = 'black', alpha = 0.01) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 19.2, y = 1.875, label = 'Delta[p] == mu[p] - mu[w]', size = 3.8, colour = 'black', parse = TRUE) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 19.2, y = 1.5, label = 'b[p] == frac(cov(mu[p] - mu[w]), var(mu[p]))', size = 3.8, colour = 'black', parse = TRUE) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 19.2, y = 1.125, label = 'hat(acc[p])', size = 3.8, colour = 'black', parse = TRUE) +

  # Se dibujan los años de toma de datos:
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 1.0, y = 2.06, label = '1984', size = 2.4, colour = 'black', angle = 45) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 8.7, y = 2.06, label = '2017', size = 2.4, colour = 'black', angle = 45) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 10.9, y = 2.06, label = '2019', size = 2.4, colour = 'black', angle = 45) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 12.0, y = 2.06, label = '2023', size = 2.4, colour = 'black', angle = 45) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 1.0, y = 1.31, label = '1984', size = 2.4, colour = 'black', angle = 45) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 8.7, y = 1.31, label = '2017', size = 2.4, colour = 'black', angle = 45) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 10.9, y = 1.31, label = '2019', size = 2.4, colour = 'black', angle = 45) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 12.0, y = 1.31, label = '2023', size = 2.4, colour = 'black', angle = 45) +

  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank())

ggsave('expo_Cartagena/Figuras/metodo_LR.png', width = 20, height = 8, units = 'cm')
```
